description: Free sample rate-decision card for any covered central bank, no payment: the bank's PREVIOUS meeting as a full card, same schema as get_policy (decision, rate, change, vote, dissent, source link), with access "full", sample_of "previous_meeting" and a disclaimer. A latest object gives the current meeting only as {meeting_date, access "paid", content_hash, buy_with}; the current decision itself is in the paid get_policy card. Policy ids: BOE, FED, ECB, BOJ, RBA, BOC, SNB, NOR, SWE, MEX, BOK, TUR, IND, ZAF, CHN, IDN, ETH, RUS, EGY, IRN, BCB, NZL.
name: sample_policy
